description: This file defines a static class 'GrainInstruments' that manages metrics instruments related to grains and system targets in Orleans. It initializes metrics counters and provides methods to increment and decrement counts for grains and system targets.

classes.name: GrainInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing instrumentation for grain and system target counts in Orleans.

methods.name: IncrementGrainCounts
methods.description: Increments the grain count for a specified grain type.

methods.name: DecrementGrainCounts
methods.description: Decrements the grain count for a specified grain type.

methods.name: IncrementSystemTargetCounts
methods.description: Increments the system target count for a specified system target type.

methods.name: DecrementSystemTargetCounts
methods.description: Decrements the system target count for a specified system target type.
